name: TOPO_BASIN_KC_AREA_344
title: Basin boundaries derived from terrain data - King County only
description:
For more information about this layer please see the GIS Data Catalog.

A delineation drainage areas that span in scale from large portions of a river basin, down to tributaries that drain to a large body receiving waters (e.g., Lake Washington). There is not a consistent method applied (for example stream order) to define scale of a basin to be identified. In general, these basins characterize large tributaries and rivers in Puget sound region. A basin is comprised of multiple catchments.
snippet: Drainage areas derived from terrain data in Puget Sound region.
